facts.fact: Ouest Tribune reports that ANIE's interim president Karim Khalfan launched a digital platform for revising and tracking electoral lists in Oran on 27 October 2025, Oran being the pilot site before generalisation nationwide.
facts.system: ANIE plateforme numérique de révision des listes électorales

systems.system: ANIE plateforme numérique de révision et de suivi des listes électorales

DZA.note: The article is about electoral-list revision, with no consultation on policy or law.
The article states nothing on local government office connection.
The article states no consultation on a digital law or policy.
